senate.description: Metropolitan Urban Service Area expansion prohibition provision

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to the Metropolitan Council; prohibiting the expansion of the Metropolitan Urban Service Area; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 473.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[473.8591] METROPOLITAN URBAN SERVICE AREA EXPANSION PROHIBITED. +]

[+Notwithstanding any law to the contrary, the Metropolitan Council is prohibited from expanding the Metropolitan Urban Service Area beyond the 2040 comprehensive plan depicted in the February 2024 Metropolitan Urban Service Area map. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective July 1, 2025. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to the Metropolitan Council; prohibiting the expansion of the Metropolitan Urban Service Area; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 473.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[473.8591] METROPOLITAN URBAN SERVICE AREA EXPANSION PROHIBITED.

Notwithstanding any law to the contrary, the Metropolitan Council is prohibited from expanding the Metropolitan Urban Service Area beyond the 2040 comprehensive plan depicted in the February 2024 Metropolitan Urban Service Area map.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective July 1, 2025.
